follow-up time: From first trimester to 35-38 weeks gestation
exposure: Residual myometrial thickness (RMT) in the first trimester
Lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness in the third trimester
outcome: Third trimester lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness
cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy and a single prior low-transverse cesarean section
finding: There was a poor correlation between first trimester RMT and third trimester LUS thickness in women with a previous cesarean section.
